## Models

Variables:

-   Nest_ID: the trapnest number, cavity number, and straw ID put together
-   Index: you can ignore this. It gave every row a unique number that I needed for a loop.
-   Status: the activity of that cavity, e.g., its empty, new cells are made, a nest is sealed off, etc.
-   Bee_choice: is a new nest built or not, Yes = 1, no = 0, pseudo nests or nests already in progress or completed get an NA.
-   Available_post: number of available cavities for each trapnest and date combo AFTER the new nests for that visit have been started (i.e., how many available cavities that the experiments saw when arriving to the nest)
-   New_nests_os: number of new osmia nests for each trapnest and date combo
-   Osmia_ps_prior: number of existing osmia in each trapnest per date, including pseudo nests
-   Osmia_no_ps_prior: number of existing osmia in each trapnest per date, excluding pseudo nests
-   New_nests_meg: number of new megachile nests for each trapnest and date combo
-   Meg_ps_prior: number of existing megachile in each trapnest per date, including pseudo nests
-   Meg_no_ps_prior: number of existing megachile in each trapnest per date, excluding pseudo nests
-   New_nests_sum: total number of new nests including megachile and osmia.
-   Available_prior: average number of available cavities for each trapnest and date combo BEFORE the new nests for that visit have been started (i.e., how many available cavities the bees saw when arriving to the nest before building). This is the average, so there are some numbers that have .5 in there. For example, if there are 8 cavities available_post and two new nests were built when we visited that trapnest, the first bee to nest would have seen 10 available cavities, and the second would have seen 9. So we average that out to 9.5 for available_prior.

```{r Setting Up}

## Loading data and packages

library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(see)
library(performance)
library(ggeffects)
library(tidyverse)



```

### Nesting per Available Cavities

```{r Models: Nest per Available Cavities}

### New nests per available cavities Osmia ###
mod_choice_cav_os <- glmer(Bee_choice ~ Available_prior + Good_days + Day_of_year + Site + (1|Subsite/Trapnest/Cavity_ID), data = nesting_os, family = binomial) # boundary singular warning

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_choice_cav_os)) # looks good feb 21
testDispersion(mod_choice_cav_os, type = 'DHARMa') # ns
testOutliers(mod_choice_cav_os, type = 'bootstrap') # ns p value = 1
summary(mod_choice_cav_os)
save(mod_choice_cav_os, file='mod_choice_cav_os.Rdata') # save models


# opitimizers_os <- allFit(mod_choice_cav_os) # did this to compare with model below that gets more warnings


### New nests per available cavities Megachile ###
mod_choice_cav_meg <- glmer(Bee_choice ~ scale(Available_prior) + scale(Good_days) + scale(Day_of_year)  + (1|Cavity_ID), data = nesting_meg, family = binomial) # Model failed to converge with max|grad|

# # check optimizors and their fits
# opitimizers <- allFit(mod_choice_cav_meg)
# # https://github.com/lme4/lme4/issues/120
# relgrad <- with(mod_choice_cav_meg@optinfo$derivs,solve(Hessian,gradient))
# max(abs(relgrad))

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_choice_cav_meg)) # overdispersed, feb 21
testDispersion(mod_choice_cav_meg, type = 'DHARMa') # significant
testOutliers(mod_choice_cav_meg, type = 'bootstrap') # 
summary(mod_choice_cav_meg)

```

### Nesting per Conspecific Presence

```{r Models: Nest per Conspecifics}

### New nests per conspecifics Osmia ###
## with pseudo ##
mod_choice_consp_os_ps <- glmer(Bee_choice ~ Osmia_ps_prior + Good_days + Day_of_year + Site + (1|Subsite/Trapnest/Cavity_ID), data = nesting_os, family = binomial) # boundary singular warning 

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_choice_consp_os_ps)) #  overdispersed, feb 21
testDispersion(mod_choice_consp_os_ps, type = 'DHARMa')  # significant
testOutliers(mod_choice_consp_os_ps, type = 'bootstrap') # 
summary(mod_choice_consp_os_ps)

### New nests per conspecifics Osmia ###
## without pseudo ##
mod_choice_consp_os_no_ps <- glmer(Bee_choice ~ Osmia_no_ps_prior + Good_days + Day_of_year + Site + (1|Subsite/Trapnest/Cavity_ID), data = nesting_os, family = binomial) # failed to converge, large eigenvalue

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_choice_consp_os_no_ps)) # overdispersed, feb 21
testDispersion(mod_choice_consp_os_no_ps, type = 'DHARMa') # significant
testOutliers(mod_choice_consp_os_no_ps, type = 'bootstrap') # 
summary(mod_choice_consp_os_no_ps)


### New nests per conspecifics Megachile ###
## with pseudo ##
mod_choice_consp_meg_ps <- glmer(Bee_choice ~ Meg_ps_prior + Good_days + Day_of_year + Site + (1|Subsite/Trapnest/Cavity_ID), data = nesting_meg, family = binomial)  # boundary singular warning 

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_choice_consp_meg_ps)) # overdispersed, feb 21
testDispersion(mod_choice_consp_meg_ps, type = 'DHARMa') # significant
testOutliers(mod_choice_consp_meg_ps, type = 'bootstrap') # 
summary(mod_choice_consp_meg_ps)

### New nests per conspecifics Megachile ###
## without pseudo ##
mod_choice_consp_meg_no_ps <- glmer(Bee_choice ~ scale(Meg_no_ps_prior) + scale(Good_days) + scale(Day_of_year) + Site + (1|Subsite/Trapnest/Cavity_ID), data = nesting_meg, family = binomial) # Model failed to converge, large egienvalue 

plot(simulateResiduals(mod_choice_consp_meg_no_ps)) # overdispersed, feb 21
testDispersion(mod_choice_consp_meg_no_ps, type = 'DHARMa') # significant
testOutliers(mod_choice_consp_meg_no_ps, type = 'bootstrap') # 
summary(mod_choice_consp_meg_no_ps)

```

### Observed and Expected values of new nests

```{r Chi Square, include=FALSE, echo=TRUE, results='hide'}


## Chi test

chisq.test(chi.os$Observed_nests, chi.os$Expected_nests)
fisher.test(chi.meg$Observed_nests, chi.meg$Expected_nests)


```

### Investment


```{r Plotting Models}

# Plot models


ggpredict(mod_choice_cav_os, c('Available_prior')) %>% plot(rawdata = TRUE, jitter = .04) + labs(x = 'Available cavities', y = 'Presence of new nest for each visit', title = 'Osmia: available cavities (full season)')



# Plot actual model
ggpredict(mod_choice_cav_meg, c('Available_prior')) %>% plot(rawdata = TRUE, jitter = .04) + labs(x = 'Available cavities', y = 'Presence of new nest for each visit', title = 'Megachile: available cavities (full season)')


# Plot actual model
ggpredict(mod_choice_consp_os_ps, c('Osmia_ps_prior')) %>% 
  plot(rawdata = TRUE, jitter = .04) + 
  labs(x = 'Osmia occupancies including pseudo', y = 'Presence of new nest for each visit', title = 'Osmia') +
  xlim(0, 18)

```
